answer:
The heaters in oxygen tank No. 2 ran on 65-volt ground power for about eight hours before launch, to empty the tank [1]. The Review Board traced the explosion to an electrically started fire in that tank [2].

The notes tie this to the switches. They were built to a 1962 specification for 28 volts DC [3]. North American Aviation revised the heater specification to 65 volts in 1965 [4].
